risk_note: Money path, RV2, no migration, no contract change. A paid_at written by W8 can fall on a bill day R2 has finished, and R2 selects by paid_at, so it was never checked. W8 now enqueues late_paid_check in its own transaction (Alipay only; proven by xmin in the rule tests). The worker reads the stored bill rows, does not rerun R2, and writes only a recon diff and a recon_diff hold through R2's own registerDiff and dedupe keys, so R2 and the job together leave one diff and one hold. It concludes paid_not_in_bill only when every relevant day has succeeded; otherwise it retries hourly up to 96 rounds and then only warns. Real risk: a false positive freezes a member (recon_diff has no expiry), so a success row on any bill day counts as matched, and run status is read before bill rows because a run commits both in one transaction. listedOn is fixed for a PAID_MANUAL entered after its bill day ran. A withdrawal entered after R2 raised unknown_line for its serial keeps that open diff, for a person to close (rule behaviour, the orchestrator is telling the owner, D10-632). The W10 enqueue is not in this task; it waits for B2-09s. No frozen test changed.

reviews.note: Codex via codex-run.sh, static, read-only. couli-runs/B2-09t/money-review-r1.json failed on one S1: bill rows were read before run status, so an R2 commit between the two reads gave a false paid_not_in_bill and a permanent hold. Fixed by reading run status first. money-review-r2.json passed at 21f01c32e. That implementation commit was then cherry-picked unchanged over the third test commit, and the change since is rule tests only. Reviewed before the rebase.

spec_test_review.note: Codex wrote the rule tests in 3 attempts, the limit; a first call was killed by the author after about a minute because its brief lacked the notes, and the tool recorded it as no-output and refunded it (uncounted_calls). A fresh Claude reviewed (approvals 19), static, not run by the reviewer. r1 failed on 3 S1 and 5 S2, r2 passed with one S2, r3 passed with no findings. r3 is outside the limit of 2: 编排例外 D10-634, incremental only, covering #34 and #35. Mutations run by the author and reverted: reading bill rows before run status turns #34 red by assertion; putting waiting ahead of an already reported row turns #35 red, by a 60 second test timeout rather than an assertion.
